cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Move your haircut so we can have lunch. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We've been friends since school. Couldn't I have its place just once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They charge twenty pounds if I change it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pay. Put lunch in that exact slot, in pen. You've used pencil for me since school.

mechanism: A confidently schedules friendship lunch but absorbs B cancellation cost and yields lunch details to make a rearranged appointment prove priority.
confusable: Unlike merely wanting company, A insists on replacing the existing slot as relationship evidence; authority survives through concessions that obtain B cooperation.
comparison: Longstanding friendship and a paid haircut change differ from a sister bargaining over public reason for leaving quiz duty.
seedUse: Use D35-a haircut/fee/ink priority seed and S02-a recasting adjustments as an organized plan.
